request: I need to reverse engineer the database of compuciber.com, so I can understand the tables and fields, in order to develop a plugin that interacts with that database. I don't have access to the WordPress backend or source code. Infer the logical database schema, relationships, taxonomies, custom post types, metadata, plugin tables, and business logic as accurately as possible from the following evidence.

evidence.about: Peruvian technology retailer (COMPUCIBER S.A.C.) focused on computers, laptops, computer components, networking equipment, printers, POS equipment and technical support services. Sells both retail and wholesale. Offers secure online purchases and technical support.

detected_plugins.name: WooCommerce
evidence: prices, sku, stock_availability, weight, dimensions fields

new_evidence.dom_analysis: By analyzing the DOM, specifically the classes wooco_wrap and wooco_component, I have identified the exact technology stack. This is not a standard WooCommerce Simple or Variable product. The site is utilizing the WPC Composite Products for WooCommerce plugin. In the WordPress database (wp_postmeta), WPC Composite Products does not store separate rows for every component. Instead, it serializes a massive array (or JSON string) under a specific meta key, usually wooco_components.
